rules.title: No outline removal without replacement
rules.rule: Never remove the outline (outline: none, outline-none, outline-0) without a verified :focus-visible replacement.

rules.title: Hit target size
rules.rule: Every interactive target is at least 32x32 CSS px (fail under 24px, warn under 32px), extending a small visual with a pseudo-element hit area.
rules.notes: Ford's decision. The 44px touch and 40px dense-desktop aims are dropped; the 24px WCAG spacing exception still applies to the fail tier.

rules.title: Hit areas never overlap
rules.rule: Extended hit areas of neighbouring controls never overlap.

rules.title: No dead zones
rules.rule: Adjacent list and menu items, and a checkbox or radio with its label, share hit area with no dead gap between them.

rules.title: Safe shortcuts
rules.rule: Shortcuts use sequences (G then I) or modifiers, avoid browser-reserved combos, and never put a destructive action on one key.

rules.title: Shortcuts ignore fields
rules.rule: Shortcuts ignore keystrokes in form fields, IME composition and key repeat.

rules.title: Enter submits
rules.rule: Fields and their submit button sit in a <form>, so Enter advances or submits each step.

rules.title: Focus the primary action
rules.rule: On a step with no input, focus moves to the primary button so Enter still works.

rules.title: Escape steps back
rules.rule: In a multi-step dialog, Escape goes back one step and closes only from the first step.

rules.title: Autofocus the next input
rules.rule: Autofocus the next input the user must fill.

rules.title: Darker shadow on hover
rules.rule: On hover use the same shadow slightly darker and transition only box-shadow.

rules.title: Press scale
rules.rule: Buttons scale to 0.95-0.98 while pressed, over about 150ms ease-out, with an opt-out.
rules.notes: Ford's decision replaces the skill's exact 0.96. Duration: skill 150ms, issue 19 200ms; the shorter wins.

rules.title: Disabled never scales
rules.rule: A disabled button never scales on press.

rules.title: Keyboard press feedback
rules.rule: Press feedback also fires on keyboard activation.

rules.title: Hover behind a media query
rules.rule: Hover-only styling sits behind @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).
rules.notes: Desktop-only apps: kept as warn because touch screens on laptops still latch hover.

rules.title: Contained overscroll
rules.rule: Scrollable dialogs, drawers, menus and side panels use overscroll-behavior: contain.

rules.title: Tap cancels on move
rules.rule: A tap cancels when the pointer moves more than 3px, so taps never fire during drags.

rules.title: Drag stays in its container
rules.rule: Free-drag elements are constrained to their container.

rules.title: Fast action feedback
rules.rule: Common actions show their result fast, optimistically when the server is slow.

rules.title: Fast page load
rules.rule: Entry pages load as fast as possible.

rules.title: Copy feedback keeps width
rules.rule: Copy feedback swaps the icon and keeps the label so the button keeps its width.

rules.title: Tooltip skip delay
rules.rule: Once a tooltip shows, neighbours show instantly for a short window, from one app-wide provider.

rules.title: Every state renders
rules.rule: Every surface renders its empty, loading, error and narrow states, and every reachable data state, with product-shaped mock data and real-use edge cases.

rules.title: Complete variant states
rules.rule: A new variant, size or theme covers hover, focus, active, disabled, loading and selected.

rules.title: Stable states
rules.rule: Loading, error and disabled states do not shift layout, rely on color alone or collapse contrast.
rules.notes: R-state-shift decides the layout-shift part for hover, focus, tab selection and opened popups; loading, error and disabled states are not exercised yet.

rules.title: Loading holds still
rules.rule: Loading and pending states hold until switched, never resolving on a timeout.

rules.title: Zoomed artwork reachable
rules.rule: Zoomed artwork stays in a scrollable viewport with every edge reachable.

rules.title: State changes never shift layout
rules.rule: Hover, selection, focus, loading and copied states never change an element's size or move its neighbours (no border added on hover, no bolder text that widens a tab).
rules.notes: R-state-shift: layout boxes before and after hover, focus, tab selection and opening a popup; a neighbour (or the control itself) moved or resized by 1px or more fails (Ford: >= 1px).
